record_note: DCRU pays ONE tranche a year rather than clean calendar halves: the audited Distribution Statement (p.151, FY end 31 Dec 2024) discloses a single undivided cash distribution of 3.58 US cents ($42,590k) 'for the period from 1 July 2023 to 30 June 2024' -- a period that straddles FY2023 (H2) and FY2024 (H1) in roughly equal, but UNDISCLOSED, proportions. No split of that $ amount or rate between the two halves is given anywhere in the AR, so per the spec we do not invent one; the whole tranche is tagged cash_paid since it was the amount actually paid to Unitholders during FY2024 and its period begins in the prior FY. Separately, a 2H2024 distribution (1.80 US cents, period 1/7/2024-31/12/2024) was declared as a Subsequent Event (announced 12 Feb 2025) -- unambiguously in respect of FY2024, tagged accrual. The audited 'Distribution per Unit' headline row (3.60c) is computed as Amount available for distribution / units (a distributable-income-per-unit metric), NOT as a sum of calendar-year-matched declared tranches -- it does not literally equal either the printed cash tranche rate (3.58c) or a clean calendar sum. Because the FY2024-in-respect-of portion of the straddling tranche is not separately disclosed, accrual_sum (1.80, the only unambiguous FY2024 accrual tranche) does not reach headline_dpu (3.60). This is an honest, expected mismatch given DCRU's rolling record-date distribution mechanic -- not an extraction error.
